That's right. And so then Benny Badman is obviously Benny Goodman, right? Okay. (LAUGHTER). And he says, now Bowman an under rated musician if there ever was one, played swell and effective piano. 'Now what about Bowman?'
Dave Bowman, yes he was a good pianist, a good musician, fine.
